about.title: About We Find Online
about.heading: Welcome to We Find Online
about.p1: We Find Online is more than just a platform—it is a vibrant digital community hub designed to empower, connect, and uplift individuals. To ensure our community has access to essential support whenever and wherever they need it, we have expanded our reach with this Progressive Web App (PWA).
about.p2: Through this platform, vital resources, community connections, and support systems are now available 24/7, from anywhere, breaking down physical barriers and meeting you right where you are.
about.collab.title: Powered by Collaboration
about.collab.p: We Find Online exists and thrives thanks to the shared vision, funding, and dedication of three incredible local non-profit organizations. Together, they combine their unique strengths to create a holistic ecosystem of support:
about.rlp.desc: Dedicated to helping individuals from refugee communities flourish. By removing language barriers, honoring diverse cultural heritages, and fostering community leaders, they help our neighbors confidently interact with the world around them.
about.sm.desc: Focused on holistic and innovative neighborhood revitalization. Using an empowerment-based model of community engagement, Square Mile builds networks of entrepreneurs, small businesses, and residents to bring renewal and restoration to under-resourced areas.
about.wfil.desc: An organization that empowers through art, service, and community. They focus on creating collaborative, creative learning environments that foster independence and help refugee neighbors in the Texas Panhandle (and abroad) live out their dreams.
about.vision.title: Our Digital Vision
about.vision.p1: By bringing the physical heart of the PLACE into a 24/7 digital space at WeFindOnline.org, we are making it easier than ever to access language resources, community development tools, and creative empowerment opportunities.
about.vision.p2: Whether you are walking through our physical doors or tapping on your phone screen, everyone deserves a PLACE.
about.notDo.title: What we don't do
about.notDo.body: The PLACE Online does not replace legal, medical, financial, immigration, or government advice. For those decisions, please talk to a qualified professional or a trusted organization.
